title: Altered chromatin accessibility and nucleosome positioning landscape upon HDAC and LSD1 inhibition in cancer cell.
authors: Sen, Sagnik; Esteve, Pierre O; Tarasia, Devesh; Danneberg, Rachel; Dey, Ashmita; Maulik, Ujjwal; Bandyopadhyay, Sanghamitra; Pradhan, Sriharsa
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究表观遗传抑制剂下染色质可及性与核小体定位变化，含TF结合分析，但核心是染色质谱而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法以测序和深度学习分析为主，缺乏三维互作机制建模。
abstract: Epigenetic enzymes, writers, readers and erasers regulate chromatin landscapes and participate in tumor heterogeneity. While therapeutic targeting of these enzymes has shown clinical promise, the comparative efficacy of mono- versus dual-inhibitor strategies remain unclear. Here, we introduce a multi-modal platform that uses NicE-viewSeq and integrates automated deep learning based spatially resolved chromatin accessibility profiling with high-throughput sequencing following epigenetic inhibitor application. Accessible chromatin landscapes were altered along with nucleosome positioning following inhibition of either LSD1 or HDACs alone, or both together. Coordinated modulation of histone marks and the CoREST complex on chromatin was observed across inhibitory conditions. Transcription factor binding analysis identified three predominant families, ETS, RUNT, and bZIP with enhanced chromatin association upon treatments. Mechanistically, a CoREST-RUNX regulatory axis was uncovered wherein JunB, a member of bZIP family displaces CoREST-RUNX at differentially accessible regions, triggering apoptotic pathways. Therefore, JunB-mediated mechanism reveals a convergent therapeutic vulnerability, offering new avenues for optimizing different combinatorial epigenetic therapy in cancer.
abstract_zh: 表观遗传酶、写入器、读取器和擦除器调控染色质景观并参与肿瘤异质性。尽管针对这些酶的治疗性靶向已显示出临床前景，但单一抑制剂与双重抑制剂策略的相对疗效仍不明确。在此，我们引入了一种多模态平台，该平台利用NicE-viewSeq，并整合了基于自动化深度学习的空间分辨染色质可及性分析，以及表观遗传抑制剂应用后的高通量测序。在单独抑制LSD1或HDACs，或两者联合抑制后，可及染色质景观随核小体定位的改变而发生变化。在多种抑制条件下，观察到组蛋白标记和CoREST复合物在染色质上的协调调节。转录因子结合分析识别出三个主要家族，ETS、RUNT和bZIP，在处理后其染色质关联增强。机制上，揭示了一个CoREST-RUNX调控轴，其中bZIP家族成员JunB在差异可及区域取代CoREST-RUNX，触发凋亡通路。因此，JunB介导的机制揭示了一个汇聚的治疗脆弱性，为优化癌症中不同的组合表观遗传治疗提供了新途径。
